description: Take one visit off a job. Use it to drop a visit from a job that has several. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. This does not itself email or text the customer. Housecall Pro still sends its own reminders as the date approaches, and that depends on your account's settings. The job record stays, and so does its schedule - this removes a visit, not the job. To take the whole job back to needs scheduling, use hcp_unschedule_job.
name: hcp_delete_job_appointment
